title: Why I was getting Buffer overflow (runtime error)
body_html:
Question:

Given an integer numRows, return the first numRows of Pascal's triangle. In Pascal's triangle, each number is the sum of the two numbers directly above it

** Example of 5 row pascal triangle:** [[1],[1,1],[1,2,1],[1,3,3,1],[1,4,6,4,1]]

/** Code should include:

  • Return an array of arrays of size *returnSize.
  • The sizes of the arrays are returned as *returnColumnSizes array.
  • Note: Both returned array and *columnSizes array must be malloced, assume caller calls free(). */

Error I was getting : Address Sanitizer::Stack-Buffer-overflow.

Why I am getting this error?

Answer that I did:

 int** generate(int numRows, int* returnSize, int** returnColumnSizes){
    int **p=(int**)malloc(numRows*sizeof(p));
    *returnSize=numRows;
    int i=0, j;
    *returnColumnSizes = (int*)malloc(sizeof(int)*numRows);
    for(i=0;i<numRows;i++)
    {
        p[i]=(int*)malloc((i+1)*sizeof(int));
        p[i][0]=1;
        if(i>=1)
        {
            p[i][i]=1;
        }
        
        for(j=1;j<=i-1;j++)
        {
            p[i][j]=p[i-1][j-1]+p[i-1][j];
        }
        *returnColumnSizes[i]=i+1;
    }
    return p;
}

Error : Address Sanitizer::Stack-Buffer-overflow

events.body_html: Please edit and show how you call generate. We need a minimal reproducible example. Also I wonder what the purpose of *returnSize=numRows is; you inconditionally assign ``numRows` to this, so it is useless.
the type of p is int**, and you allocate memory for multiple int**s due to the sizeof(p) It may work but it is an error, you want to allocate for multiple int*. Therefore you should use sizeof(int*)
